notes: Version 2.32 records Gravity 3.5 and its consumer cascade (Q12 1.6, Q13 1.6, EG-Note 2.2, SG-Note 2.3, LC-O2 1.3). Gravity works on a supplied Riemannian metric: its identification with an operator built from the admissibility data is not established, [H-lift] is open and not discharged by Q9, Q5b gives a rank-three co-metric, no metric coefficient value is established, and reading the metric as emergent needs a supplied rank-four extension and a continuation that is not performed. The infrared dominance of the Einstein term is typed as structural and conditional (a non-zero matched coefficient and R L_4^2 << 1, by power counting, with no general bound on the non-local terms). Among linear two-derivative carriers the Born-Infeld classification leaves a trace parameter alpha of the spectral carrier free, with second-order data determining at most |1 - alpha d|; the saturation condition applied to the Ricci endomorphism selects alpha = 0, and the non-uniqueness lies in the sector function. LC-O2 uses a supplied Lorentzian co-metric with a postulated flat temporal reference, and its weak-field corollary restates the lapse of a supplied metric. The registry entries, table rows and graph nodes are updated; the edges Q11 to Gravity and Gravity to LCII are removed as result dependencies, and conditional edges Q11 to LCII and Q5b to LCII record the homogeneous form LCII takes from Q11 Corollary 6.1 under its hypotheses and the rank-three co-metric of Q5b.
